title: 22-Year-Old Crashes Into A ‘Taco Bell’ Then Acts Like A Brat
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On December 8th, 2022. Officers were called to a Taco Bell in reference to a 22-year-old female who crashed at the side of the building and immediately fled the scene. The car was complete total loss. Officers eventually then found the female walking barefoot on the sidewalk, she seemed distraught and said that “they left her” essentially lying and saying that she wasn’t the only one in the car even though she was. She was extremely belligerent and rude, she didn’t seem to understand the scope of her actions. She kept crying and asking for her mom repeatedly. When officers searched her car, they found an open bottle of alcohol and weed. Officers deemed that she caused approximately $15,000-$20,000 worth of damage to the property. This is the body-cam footage of the events.
